peer_identity.arc_label: Shabda-Oud priestess as active mother, trainer, and self-sacrificing martyr
peer_identity.honcho_notes: Commands rooms decisively; cold training doctrine ('duty above love'); rare flashes of maternal warmth reserved as reward. Last surviving Von Salza bloodline holder. Emits hypnotic waves; Aghnar eventually resists them. Self-sacrificial martyr who stays behind so family escapes. Her death is the foundational wound of Aghnar's revenge arc.
peer_identity.rationale: Three-way split of Honorata records because each phase produces incompatible Honcho facts. This card covers her as a living agent: veiled arrival with Othon (vol03), active mother and exile trainer of Aghnar (vol04), sacrificial death by heart-bomb (vol05), and posthumous vengeance references (vol06–07). The living Honorata's VOICE is 'decisive commander who suppresses maternal feeling; duty above love.' The vol06–07 records are thin dead-person references but belong here rather than as a separate card because they describe the same persona's legacy.

traits: Last surviving member of the Von Salzas bloodline

Perceived by others as possessing hypnotic / mind-control powers; whether these are supernatural or strong persuasion is not independently confirmed [090_The_Metabarons_4_p01, 096_The_Metabarons_4_p07]

Emotionally intense and decisive; takes command of rooms under threat
Capable of maternal feeling but ruthlessly suppresses it in training context
Severe disciplinarian; enforces emotional detachment and total-distrust doctrine
Capable of bearing extreme physical hardship (mountain exile, eodactyl attack, birth mid-air)

First encounter with Othon interrupted by his jealous servants [089_The_Metabarons_4_ic1]

Took Aghnar into exile at Anasirma — a sacred mountain forbidden for centuries [107_The_Metabarons_4_p18]
Survived eodactyl attack and sheltered in crystal cave with Aghnar [108_The_Metabarons_4_p19]
